concerns.text: The plan treats the three sentiment ratio fields (`sentiment_pos_ratio`, `sentiment_neg_ratio`, `sentiment_neu_ratio`) as independent predictors in the VAR/VECM modeling pipeline, yet by definition they sum to 1 for every quarter. This perfect linear dependence introduces multicollinearity (rank deficiency) into the VAR system, violating the assumption of independent time‑series inputs and rendering coefficient estimates non‑identifiable. The plan does not include any step to address this redundancy (e.g., dropping one ratio, using a compositional data transformation, or applying a dimensionality‑reduction technique). Consequently, the core causal inference results (Granger tests, impulse‑response analysis) are scientifically unsound.
